title: Human performance
verified_evidence: Open Library search.json q=fitts posner human performance returned work OL6554807W 'Human performance' first published 1967 (Brooks/Cole, Belmont, Calif., 162 pages, per editions.json) and OL29344953W listing Fitts and Posner as authors; Anderson 1982 full text cites 'Fitts & Posner, 1967' for the practice power law.
